chunks: Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, informed me from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from his father, from Saʿd ibn ʿAbd Allah, from Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad, from ʿAlī ibn al-Ḥakam, from ʿUthmān ibn ʿAbd al-Malik, from Abū Saʿīd al-Mukārī, from Abī ʿAbd Allah عليه السلام, who said:
"If a mouse falls into the well and its skin comes off, then draw seven buckets from it."
Thus, this hadith was an explanation of the two preceding hadiths.

key_terms.الْبِئْرِ: the well; the water source being discussed
key_terms.الْفَأْرَةُ: a mouse; the impure animal mentioned in the ruling
key_terms.دِلَاءٍ: buckets; the units of water to be drawn out
key_terms.سَبْعَ: seven; the specified number in the ruling
key_terms.فَانْزَحْ: then draw out; an instruction to remove water from the well
key_terms.فَتَسَلَّخَتْ: its skin came off; indicating decomposition or disintegration of the carcass
key_terms.مُفَسِّرًا: clarifying; showing that this report explains earlier narrations

ai.seo_question: What should be done if a mouse falls into a well and decomposes in it according to a hadith from Tahdhīb al-Aḥkām?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning ritual purity when a mouse falls into a well and decomposes. It specifies that seven buckets should be drawn from the well, and the closing note indicates that this report clarifies the meaning of the two previous hadiths.
